findings.section: Magnitude, unit normal, spacing table rows
findings.defect: Unescaped vertical bars in |v|, g_h/|g_h| and 1/|g_h| split the Markdown table into extra cells.
findings.correction: Escape all magnitude delimiter pipes inside table cells, or use magnitude(v) notation.
findings.verification: Inspect table row delimiter counts after correction. Magnitude delimiters are escaped or replaced by magnitude(...) notation; all table rows now have four cells by unescaped-delimiter check.

findings.defect: CAP-05 requires a computed physical cosine, but the only prior answered practice C04.05-P1 computes zero dot products and a squared length. The cosine formula is explained and worked in W1, yet no learner practice item asks for a cosine calculation. E05 requires prior independently answered practice for each concrete operation.
findings.correction: Add a short answered practice asking learners to compute a nonzero physical cosine from two address displacements using their physical images; map that practice explicitly in CAP-05. For example e1 and (1,1,0) map to (1,0,0) and (2,2,0), giving cosine 1/sqrt(2).
findings.verification: Inspect new practice prompt and worked answer; independently recompute dot 2 and magnitudes 1,sqrt(8), then confirm capstone backward map cites it. Re-read updated C04.05-P1, new C04.05-P2 and CAP-05 E05 row. P1 now practices zero cosines; P2 explicitly prompts physical images, dot product, magnitudes and nonzero cosine, with correct worked answer. Independently recomputed dot=2, squared magnitudes=1,8, hence cosine=1/sqrt(2). CAP-05 explicitly links P2. Finding closed.

findings.defect: Initial exact checker used integer norm-squared constants, allowing Python division to introduce floating values and causing 0.20000000000000004 != 0.2.
findings.correction: Represent every squared norm as Fraction before division, including 1 and 5.
findings.verification: Reran the complete exact checker successfully; doubled-label squared spacing equals Fraction(1,5).

checks.method: Full text review plus exact component recomputation; bridge, definitions, units, logic, evidence scope, four diagnostic answers and next dependencies inspected.
q -> x -> q and q=z+u checks; negative floor and exact endpoint rules verified.
Three dot pairings for each g; affine plane origin; nonzero h; orientation and doubled-level family checked. Canonical and stale source branches inspected in place.
Physical and address dots, both cross-term signs, cosine practice, exact reconstruction and retained display residuals; E05 input/output/practice links inspected.
Independent reviewer read all six lessons and supporting materials; findings corrected at earliest teaching source. Independent verification and manager exact checks retained separately.
Markdown delivery reviewed for table delimiters, equation legibility and local links. No paginated outputs requested, so PDF render gate is not applicable.
Executed required project-root validator: exit 0, zero errors; containment, all checkpoint hashes, assembly identity/order, audit and completion validated.

limitations: Pacing has not been tested with a live class.
